Callout.Name: Gunshot Wound
Callout.Advisory: Wound to the shoulder, caller applying pressure.

Script.Line: It came from the car. I did not see a face.
I felt it before I heard it. That is the strange part.
Is there a lot of blood? Do not lie to me about the blood.

Callout.Patient: I cannot move my arm. Tell me it is still there.

Lines.Approach: He has been shot in the shoulder and the caller is holding it. Suspect has gone - the patient comes first.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
